name: Qwen3-TTS (Alibaba)
blurb: Apache-2.0. 3-second rapid cloning, strong emotion control, plus VoiceDesign: describe a voice in plain words and get it.

models.name: 1.7B VoiceDesign — voice from a text description

params.label: Voice description (VoiceDesign model)
params.help: E.g. 'A warm, deep male narrator voice, slow and calm'. Only used by the VoiceDesign model.

params.label: Seed (0 = random)
params.help: Fix a seed to reproduce a take you liked.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the finished voice up/down. ±2–3 stays natural; bigger = character voices.

params.label: Loudness normalize (0/1)
params.help: Match every take to a consistent loudness (-18 LUFS).
